prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE entirely new production sprite for the Four Realms playing-card skin in Balatro Portrait. This is NEW ART from scratch. ONE cohesive classic Balatro-compatible chunky pixel-art style across the set. The final illustration is imported into a 47-by-79-pixel art area inside a native 71-by-95 playing card, so design for extremely small mobile readability. Treat the art as a native roughly 45-by-73-pixel bitmap, enlarged with nearest-neighbor: large flat clusters, uniform dark 1-pixel outlines, at most 12 deliberate colours, 2 or 3 shade steps per material, simple hard edge highlights, clear negative spaces. No soft painting, antialiasing, gradients, blur, grain, dithering, intricate linework, tiny jewellery or detailed fabric patterns. Transparent background, isolated upright portrait with even 8% transparent margins, no card stock, card border, ranks, letters, suit index, writing, logo or watermark. For court figures, use ONE single waist-up upright figure (not mirrored, not full body, no second head), face at upper third large and readable, shoulders and hands contained in a narrow portrait silhouette, same character scale throughout all courts, large graphic costumes and one clear signature object. No Joker hat or jester costume. For aces use ONE centred suit-theme emblem, same bold outline and graphic cluster style. Deliver portrait proportions, fully within frame, genuinely transparent background. Subject: HEARTS KING. An ORIGINAL brutal blood monarch/executioner with a broad red iron crown integrated into a dark executioner hood, stern masked face, crimson plate armour with bold heart-shaped breastplate and a heavy double-headed axe held beside him. Thick red/black shapes, one silver blade accent, regal imposing stance. No graphic injury.
